steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and coarsely grate the beet; squeeze out excess moisture using a clean cloth.
Mash the drained cooked chickpeas in a large bowl until mostly smooth with some texture.
Add the grated beet, chickpea flour, ground flaxseed, cumin, coconut milk, and coconut oil to the bowl.
Mix until a firm dough forms; if it feels wet, add a little more chickpea flour.
Divide into 16 equal portions and roll each into a ball; place on the prepared sheet.
Flatten each ball slightly and bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until firm and lightly golden on the bottom.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving. Store refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
